entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:1
segments: ¶"You [are] the children of the LORD your God; you shall not cut yourselves nor shave the front of your head for the dead.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:2
segments: "For you [are] a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a people for Himself, a special treasure above all the peoples who [are] on the face of the earth.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:3
segments: "You shall not eat any detestable thing.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:4
segments: "These [are] the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:5
segments: "the deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the mountain goat, the antelope, and the mountain sheep.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:6
segments: "And you may eat every animal with cloven hooves, having the hoof split into two parts, [and that] chews the cud, among the animals.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:7
segments: "Nevertheless, of those that chew the cud or have cloven hooves, you shall not eat, [such as] these: the camel, the hare, and the rock hyrax; for they chew the cud but do not have cloven hooves; they [are] unclean for you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:8
segments: "Also the swine is unclean for you, because it has cloven hooves, yet [does] not [chew] the cud; you shall not eat their flesh or touch their dead carcasses.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:9
segments: "These you may eat of all that [are] in the waters: you may eat all that have fins and scales.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:10
segments: "And whatever does not have fins and scales you shall not eat; it [is] unclean for you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:11
segments: "All clean birds you may eat.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:12
segments: "But these you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the buzzard,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:13
segments: "the red kite, the falcon, and the kite after their kinds;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:14
segments: "every raven after its kind;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:15
segments: "the ostrich, the short-eared owl, the seagull, and the hawk after their kinds;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:16
segments: "the little owl, the screech owl, the white owl,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:17
segments: "the jackdaw, the carrion vulture, the fisher owl,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:18
segments: "the stork, the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe and the bat.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:19
segments: "Also every creeping thing that flies is unclean for you; they shall not be eaten.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:20
segments: "You may eat all clean birds.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:21
segments: "You shall not eat anything that dies [of itself]; you may give it to the alien who [is] within your gates, that he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you [are] a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:22
segments: ¶"You shall truly tithe all the increase of your grain that the field produces year by year.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:23
segments: "And you shall eat before the LORD your God, in the place where He chooses to make His name abide, the tithe of your grain and your new wine and your oil, of the firstborn of your herds and your flocks, that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:24
segments: "But if the journey is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry [the tithe, or] if the place where the LORD your God chooses to put His name is too far from you, when the LORD your God has blessed you,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:25
segments: "then you shall exchange [it] for money, take the money in your hand, and go to the place which the LORD your God chooses.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:26
segments: "And you shall spend that money for whatever your heart desires: for oxen or sheep, for wine or similar drink, for whatever your heart desires; you shall eat there before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:27
segments: "You shall not forsake the Levite who [is] within your gates, for he has no part nor inheritance with you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:28
segments: "At the end of [every] third year you shall bring out the tithe of your produce of that year and store [it] up within your gates.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:29
segments: "And the Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, and the stranger and the fatherless and the widow who [are] within your gates, may come and eat and be satisfied, that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.
